title: Implicit state machine refinements
guidingPrinciple: Elevate UX, DX, and AX together without breaking wire protocol or adopter-facing APIs. Prefer additive enums/snapshots in core; thin app facades keep existing bindings.

decisions.machine: Client sync session lifecycle (MAUI + Blazor hosts)
implicitBefore: MauiSyncBootstrapper: _started + nullable CTS + free-form status strings
decisions.decision: Introduce core ISyncSession + SyncSessionPhase + SyncSessionSnapshot + SyncClientSession; MAUI/Blazor become thin adapters.
decisions.ux: One status vocabulary (Connecting/CatchingUp/Live/OfflinePolling/Reconnecting/Degraded) with stable DisplayStatus; no false 'Connected' when SignalR is disabled.
decisions.dx: Single place to reason about host loops; AddSyncEngineClientSession for periodic-pull opt-in.
decisions.ax: Agents edit SyncClientSession once instead of two divergent hosts; enums are greppable contracts.
decisions.compatibility: MauiSyncBootstrapper keeps StatusChanged/ErrorRaised/SyncCompleted string API. Blazor FacilityViewSyncStatus expanded additively.

implicitBefore: Hosts assumed Connected after StartAsync even when EnableSignalR=false
decisions.decision: Add SyncHubLinkState + LinkState/LinkStateChanged on ISyncWakeListener; SignalR listener publishes Disabled/Connecting/Connected/Reconnecting/Failed/Disconnected; reject double-start.
decisions.ux: UI can show Reconnecting and OfflinePolling from real hub events.
decisions.dx: Connection state is one property, not inferred from exceptions.
decisions.ax: Safe to extend hub lifecycle without hunting string status writes.

implicitBefore: No public phase for gap vs stream vs HTTP
decisions.decision: Add SyncApplyPhase + ApplyPhaseChanged; SyncClientSession maps GapRepair/HttpCatchUp → CatchingUp and ApplyingStream → Syncing when appropriate. Do not reorder lock/catch-up semantics.
decisions.ux: Catch-up vs live stream is visible to session consumers.
decisions.dx: Phase names match product-contract language (gap → HTTP pull).
decisions.ax: Agents can subscribe to phases instead of parsing logs.
decisions.compatibility: Additive event only; pull ordering unchanged.

decisions.decision: Add SyncTransportMode + SyncClientOptions.ResolveTransportMode(); keep booleans as configuration source of truth for now.
decisions.dx: Named modes document intended operating points.

implicitBefore: Failures looked like generic network errors
decisions.decision: Add SyncCredentialState + optional ISyncCredentialStatus; ClientCredentialsTokenProvider publishes Unconfigured/Valid/Refreshing/Expired/Failed. Defer 401-forced refresh to a follow-up to avoid HTTP handler behavior change this pass.
decisions.ux: Foundation to show auth failures distinctly from sync/network errors.
decisions.followUp: Wire 401 → force refresh in SyncAuthDelegatingHandler; fold Failed into SyncSessionSnapshot.Detail.

implicitBefore: Apps do not auto-flush on reconnect
decisions.decision: Expose SyncOutboxPhase + PhaseChanged on ClientOutbox. Defer OfflineSyncCoordinator (flush-on-reconnect) to avoid changing demo mutation paths this pass.
decisions.ux: Outbox can drive a pending-count badge later without guessing.
decisions.followUp: IOfflineSyncCoordinator: OnConnectivityRestored → Flush → Pull; generator hooks for entity writes.

decisions.decision: Expand FacilityViewSyncStatus with CatchingUp/Offline/Reconnecting; map from SyncSessionSnapshot; extract UiRefreshCoalescer (Idle/Running/DirtyWhileRunning). MarkAppliedBatch no longer forces Live (session owns phase).
decisions.ux: Pill reflects offline/reconnect/catch-up; offline successful polls stay Offline.
decisions.dx: UI enum documented as projection of SyncSessionPhase.
decisions.ax: Refresh coalescer is a named SM agents can reuse.
decisions.compatibility: CSS adds offline pill; existing classes preserved.

decisions.decision: Add OrgStoreSessionState (Idle/Open/TransactionOpen/Disposed); keep HasActiveTransaction as derived convenience for ChangeLedgerWriter wake deferral.
decisions.ux: No direct UX; clearer wake timing contract for reliability.
decisions.ax: Agents less likely to break wake-on-commit by flipping a naked bool.
decisions.compatibility: HasActiveTransaction retained; SessionState additive on IOrgStore (two implementors updated).

decisions.ux: Telemetry/load UI can distinguish failure from success.
decisions.compatibility: Additive enum value; ToString() API gains 'Failed'.

decisions.decision: Defer control-flow rewrite. Prefer additive NotifierPhase telemetry in a follow-up to avoid latency/coalesce regressions.
decisions.ax: Avoid risky rewrite without telemetry hooks first.

implicitBefore: Generator emits DI/handlers only; every adopter reinvents session host
decisions.decision: Ship SyncClientSession in Client package (opt-in via existing AddSyncEngineClient + AddSyncEngineClientSession). Do not force-generate host runners; document adopter path and wire PlugAndPlay with SyncSessionHostedService.
decisions.ux: Adopters get correct status if they use ISyncSession.
decisions.dx: One recommended host instead of copy-paste Aviation code.
decisions.ax: Generator remains schema-focused; lifecycle lives in reusable core (easier for agents than emitted one-offs).
decisions.compatibility: Opt-in runAsHostedService; Aviation UI hosts keep thin adapters.

decisions.decision: Keep as one-shot init flags. Expose checkpoint on SyncSessionSnapshot via successful pull ToVersion (already done) rather than wrapping Lazy init.
Defer typed presence bag; telemetry already records connect/disconnect.
decisions.ax: Leave until telemetry dashboard needs presence.
